question: Does the distributive L9H1+L11H3+L15H5 union carry temporal and is-was command swaps simultaneously with small cross-command interaction?
scope: The parent remains a registered singleton/module identification null because B/C failed. Its preregistered D clause passed and explicitly licenses use of the three-head greedy union. This experiment tests that distributed union as one program; it does not retro-pass any singleton claim.

frozen_design.population: All 32 licensed rows and all four native cells serve as anchors, for 128 anchored examples. No row, direction, template, or phase is selected.
frozen_design.arms: One native capture plus temporal-only union swap, is-was-only union swap, and simultaneous union swap. Each union replaces the 128-dimensional L9H1, L11H3, and L15H5 pre-c_proj slices at the query immediately before the relevant answer. Single arms use the paired cell differing in one bit. The simultaneous arm applies both independent single-command donor substitutions in the same forward.
frozen_design.outputs: Score canonical will-minus-had and is-minus-was margins on every arm. Apply the exact 00/10/01/11 Möbius contract separately by output role, phase, and template. Also report each role's signed recovery against its native paired-cell gold and the other command's collateral.
frozen_design.bars: In both FIT and HOLDOUT, temporal-only signed recovery must be >=.60 and is-was-only >=.40, each with cosine >=.98 and direction agreement 1.0. Single-arm other-role norm is <=.01 of target gold and is-was-to-earlier-temporal max absolute effect <=1e-5. For each role, phase, and template, joint interaction RMS/both RMS <=.10 and additive cosine >=.99. In the simultaneous arm, each role retains at least its single-arm signed recovery minus .05.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_pairing_reprodu: Authorities, all-row license ancestry, exact pairs/positions, parent single-union metric replay, finite closure, configuration, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_single_command_union_effects_rema: Both roles pass their frozen FIT/HOLDOUT recovery, cosine, direction, collateral, and causal-zero bars.
predictions.pred_c_simultaneous_union_is_additive_ac: Every role x phase x template Möbius interaction ratio is <=.10 and additive cosine is >=.99.
predictions.pred_d_simultaneous_arm_preserves_each_s: For each role and phase, simultaneous-arm signed recovery is no more than .05 below its corresponding single-arm recovery.
predictions.pred_e_distributed_joint_union_is_licens: A/B/C/D all pass without changing the parent singleton/module null.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E identifies a distributed three-head joint program with task-typed state and shared physical interfaces. B pass with C/D failure identifies shared but interacting execution and routes to the exact command-order/factorial decomposition. B failure closes this union on the dual population. No singleton module is promoted by this result.
